import subprocess, sys

# R1: No arguments → SystemExit
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("No args exit code:", r.returncode, "(expected non-zero)")
print("stderr:", repr(r.stderr[:200]))

# R1: bump without args → help  
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "bump"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("\nbump no args exit code:", r.returncode, "(expected 0)")
print("stdout preview:", repr(r.stdout[:300]))

# check subcommand
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "check", "1.0.0"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("\ncheck valid exit code:", r.returncode, "(expected 0)")
print("check valid stdout:", repr(r.stdout))

r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "semver", "check", "invalid"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("check invalid exit code:", r.returncode, "(expected non-zero)")
print("check invalid stdout:", repr(r.stdout))
